title: Cloud 2048 Match
description: Drop fluffy sky-blue number tiles onto dreamy cloud columns—chain cascading 2048 merges in a soothing, ultra-smooth arcade puzzler.
controls: Tap a column to drop the active number tile onto matching numbers and chain higher merges.

zh-CN.title: 浮云 2048 消消乐
zh-CN.description: 清新治愈浮云 2048 消消乐：在蓝天白云间落下数字云朵触发连锁合成升级，轻松合出 2048 超级减压！
zh-CN.controls: 点击任意一列投放数字方块，相同数字碰撞自动合体升级冲击 2048 以上高分。
